reason: 15 dollars plus the moto delivery is almost a week of what I earn, and at the market I find an iron for much less. And this one still needs the current to heat on its base, so when SNEL cuts, it does nothing more than my old iron.
objection: I already bought a Chinese appliance that died after a few weeks. A seller I only know from Facebook, with no shop I can go back to, who replaces it if the socle breaks after a month?
would_change_my_mind: A price close to the market, around 8 dollars delivery included, with a written guarantee and a real place in Kinshasa where I can bring it back if it breaks.
